story_info.title: Penny Penguin Shares Sweet Berries

slides.title: A Sunny Saturday Snack
slides.text: Penny Penguin loved Saturdays. She loved going to Blossom Meadow. "Healthy habits make every day fun!" she sang. Today, she wanted to pick sweet, juicy berries. They would make a yummy, healthy snack. Penny got her little basket ready. She put on her sunny hat. Off she went, waddling happily.
slides.speaker_notes: Penny is excited for her berry picking adventure in the meadow.

slides.title: Berries in Blossom Meadow
slides.text: The sun was shining bright. Bumblebees buzzed near colourful flowers. Penny reached Blossom Meadow. She saw so many red and blue berries. They looked plump and ready to eat. Penny carefully picked a few. She put them gently into her basket. She hummed a happy tune.
slides.speaker_notes: Penny enjoys the beautiful meadow while picking berries.

slides.title: Rina Rabbit Rushes In
slides.text: Suddenly, a little blur of white zoomed past. It was Rina Rabbit! Rina wanted berries too. "Berries!" Rina hopped quickly. She tried to grab a big handful from Penny’s basket. "Wait, Rina!" Penny said softly. "It is good to ask first." Rina stopped. She looked at Penny with wide eyes.
slides.speaker_notes: Rina Rabbit appears and tries to take berries without asking.

slides.title: Learning to Say 'Please'
slides.text: Penny smiled. "To be polite, we say 'Please'," she said gently. Rina twitched her pink nose. "Please, Penny?" she asked. Penny shared some bright red berries from her basket. "Thank you, Penny!" Rina hopped with joy. Good manners felt warm like sunshine. They both felt happy.
slides.speaker_notes: Penny teaches Rina to use 'please' and 'thank you', sharing berries.

slides.title: Sweet Berries, Sweet Friends
slides.text: Penny and Rina ate their berries. They tasted so sweet and fresh. Sharing made the snack even better. Rina learned a kind new way to ask and thank. Penny felt happy that Rina learned. "Healthy habits make every day fun!" Penny chirped. Good manners always help us make friends and feel good.
slides.speaker_notes: Penny and Rina enjoy their shared snack, reinforcing the lesson of good manners.
